title: Agent stages keep the user's notes and speak in credits
gap: Redraft notes are cleared even when the start fails: BriefStage.tsx:247 and BeatsStage.tsx:331 do runs.start().then(() => setNotes('')), and use-agent-runs.ts:120 catches every error, so the promise always resolves. BriefStage.tsx:136 shows '$… ceiling' to customers billed in credits. Deleting a scene, beat or shot in Beats has no confirmation and no undo.
target: start() resolves to a boolean, and notes are cleared only on true. The quote line shows credits only unless the workspace pays its vendors in USD. Beats deletes go through the shell undo stack with a '⌘Z to undo' toast.
respects_rules: Undo keeps team data recoverable, and credits are shown before any agent spend.
